question.text: No Valuer of an InvIT shall undertake valuation for the same project for more than how many consecutive years?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under InvIT Regulations, no valuer shall undertake valuation for the same project for more than 4 years consecutively. The Trap: 5 years is a common rotation period for auditors in some contexts, but the InvIT valuer rotation is set at a stricter 4 years. Note: The same 4-year consecutive-valuation limit applies to REIT valuers under the comparable rule.
